forum.title: FreeRTOS With TouchGFX
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello PeterVang,

I thought I posted an answer to this post.  I actually figured it out.  I ended up putting an osDelay(200) before the for(;;) loop in the UART\_Task and that worked.  Thank you for checking up and trying to help!
